title: Braised Beef Tips in Red Wine + Video
reject_reason: Beef tips braised in dry-red-wine and beef-broth sauce with shallot, bacon fat, butter and thyme is the same red-wine beef braise dinner as live beef-bourguignon-bowls; the estate has already rejected this identity twice (beef cheeks, beef bourguignon).
